#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class Test {
public:
  static ofstream writer;
  int R, C;
  long long ch[61][61];
  int cntA[61], cntB[61];
  long long best;
  string str;
  map<long long, long long> cache;
  set<long long> tried;

  static void init() {
    writer.open("output.txt");
  }

  static int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    char c;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF && !isdigit(c));
    if (c == '-') {
      neg = true;
      c = getchar();
    }
    while (isdigit(c)) {
      ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
      c = getchar();
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static long long readLong() {
    long long ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    char c;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF && !isdigit(c));
    if (c == '-') {
      neg = true;
      c = getchar();
    }
    while (isdigit(c)) {
      ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
      c = getchar();
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static string readString() {
    string ans;
    char c;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF && !isalnum(c));
    while (isalnum(c)) {
      ans += c;
      c = getchar();
    }
    return ans;
  }

  void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
    if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
      if (diff < best) best = diff;
      return;
    }
    long long key = x * 10_000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    if (tried.find(key) != tried.end()) return;
    if (v1 >= R) {
      long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long long other = ch[v2][R];
      dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= R) {
      long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long long other = ch[v1][R];
      dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    tried.insert(key);
  }

  long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
    long long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    auto it = cache.find(key);
    if (it != cache.end()) return it->second;
    if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
      if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
        int sum = v1 + v2;
        v1 -= cntA[sum];
        v2 -= cntB[sum];
        return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
      }
      return 0;
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (c != 'B') {
      long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long long other = ch[v2][R];
      ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A') {
      long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long long other = ch[v1][R];
      ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    cache[key] = ans;
    return ans;
  }

  void start() {
    R = readInt();
    C = readInt();
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R + C); i++)
      for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++)
        if (j == 0 || j == i) ch[i][j] = 1;
        else ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j - 1] + ch[i - 1][j];
    long long x = 0, y = 0;
    int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
    while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R)
      if (x > y) {
        long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
        long long other = ch[v2][R];
        y += cur * other;
        v1--;
      } else {
        long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
        long long other = ch[v1][R];
        x += cur * other;
        v2--;
      }
    best = abs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    str = readString();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
      cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
      cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    writer << ans << endl;
  }
};

ofstream Test::writer;

int main() {
  Test::init();
  Test te;
  te.start();
  Test::writer.close();
  return 0;
}
